loveLaughsatAndyHardy: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy is a 1946 American comedy film directed by Willis Goldbeck and starring Mickey Rooney, Lewis Stone and Bonita Granville. It was produced by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. The film is also known under its American promotional title Uncle Andy Hardy. rv: I wish all of the Andy Hardy movies could be here on archive.org. This is one of my favorite movie series of all time. The series follows Andy (played by Mickey Rooney) through out his life, from high school all the way to the end of his college career. The entire cast returns for the whole series, reprising their respective roles. In this delightful episode, Andy returns from serving in WWII, completely in love with the idea of marrying his college sweetheart. He re-enters his college life only to find that she has other plans.
The part where they ask him to be the best man and he throws rice at them as they drive off is the most depressing and pathetic scene that has ever been filmed.
